messages:
toshi: Heads-up — CloudRes is launching a 72-hr 'AI Accelerator' marketplace listing starting 2026-11-25 with promo credits. Partner expects a 4–6x uplift in marketplace traffic, mostly embeddings + some chat. They asked for a capacity commitment. Can infra/capacity give a quick GPU-hour estimate and region impact? cc @maria @aj

maria (partnerships): Seen. They provided usage split: ~70% embeddings, ~30% chat gen. Peak window estimate: 150–200 QPS in eu-west. Baseline marketplace EU avg ~40 QPS.

aj (infra): Tagging capacity. Quick question — what spare headroom do we have in eu-west today? We currently show 12 T4 pools and 6 A100 pools attached to marketplace routing.

liam (capacity): Quick back-of-envelope based on their multipliers. Embeddings cheaper per token. Calc below (very rough, assumes batching is similar to baseline):
```
baseline qps: 40 -> ~1.5 GPU-hours/hr (emb-heavy mixed)
peak x5: 200 qps -> ~7.5 GPU-hours/hr
promo duration: 72 hr -> 540 GPU-hours
+30% buffer -> ~702 GPU-hours needed
```
This ignores accelerated batching improvements and quantized variants.

aj (infra): We can't spin up extra A100s in eu-west quickly due to provider lead times. Options: 1) shift some Dedicated spare capacity from us-west, 2) enable cross-region routing to us-west, or 3) throttle partner traffic. Any SLA constraints?

zara (sales): Partner requires <200ms median for chat. They'll accept eu->us-west fallback if we can keep median <280ms. They want the promo live starting day 1; ramping is negotiable.

maria (partnerships): Flag risk: cross-region will increase egress cost and add latency variability. Also watch per-tenant quotas.

finance-bot: Rough egress uplift estimate for expected profile to us-west ~ $8,200 over 72 hours. Partner coupon offered $12,000 credit. Net looks positive but depends on instance mix.

toshi (partnerships): Ops ask — can we implement a temporary per-reseller quota cap/ramp so we don't see a flash spike that impacts other marketplace partners? Suggested ramp: 25% first 6h, 50% next 18h, then full if health OK.

aj (infra): We can implement ramping via a routing policy. We'll also add auto-fallback to a lower-memory quantized model for embeddings to reduce GPU time. Proposed routing policy steps: create policy 'cloudres-promo-2026', apply to marketplace tag, health-check windows 60s.

liam (capacity): Recommend enabling the quantized embeddings variant (q4_1 or similar) — should cut GPU-hours by ~30–40% for embedding-heavy traffic with minimal quality loss. That reduces the 702 -> ~490 GPU-hours.

eng-oncall: If we cross-region, we need explicit health probes and alerts for network egress > threshold, CPU steal on hosts, and queue latency. Also increase cache TTLs for common prefixes to reduce repetitive load. I'll prepare alert thresholds.

aj (infra): Follow-ups from infra: 1) I'll draft routing PR for gradual ramp, 2) create temporary cross-region route with fallbacks, 3) ensure autoscale policies have sensible upper bounds so we don't overspend.

toshi: Proposed owner split: maria to confirm partner accepts ramp & quantized variant; aj to implement routing policy + cross-region fallback; liam to prepare quantized model version and load test; eng-oncall to prepare runbook and alerts. Meeting 30m at 16:00 to sign off. :thumbsup:

maria (partnerships): Confirmed with partner — they accept ramping and quantized embeddings. Sending signed addendum now.

aj (infra): Starting routing PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/512 — will add health-check logic and staged rollout flags. :shipit:

liam (capacity): Quantization pipeline queued, packing embeddings model q4_1 variant. ETA ~10h for validation and 2h for canary.

eng-oncall: Runbook draft uploaded: /docs/runbooks/marketplace-spike.md — includes steps to toggle routing policy, fallback to lower-qps, and emergency kill-switch.

deploy-bot: Autoscales triggered: created temp routing policy 'cloudres-promo-2026' (id: rp-6632), and attached us-west fallback route.

toshi (partnerships): Thanks all — after 16:00 I'll update partner and post summary to #ops. Let's monitor first 12h closely.

aj (infra): Note: we'll enable extra tracing for a 48h window to capture tail latency for cross-region calls.

finance-bot: Final rough P&L after quantization and egress: estimated revenue credit $12k - egress $8.2k - extra infra ops < $2k -> net ~ +$1.8k. Margin small but strategic for partner relationship.

toshi: Agreed — strategic value = channel growth + marketplace visibility. Proceed with ramp plan.
